mapper.select: -- 요청 재전송은 원래 준비 원장을 반환한다. 사유·요청 키는 공개 DTO에 포함하지 않는다. SELECT id,policy_id,requested_by,request_hash FROM announcement_attachment_policy_publication_scopes WHERE idempotency_key=#{key}
mapper.insert: -- DRAFT/ACTIVE 규칙만 준비한다. QA가 최신 동일 입력의 VERIFIED metadata가 아니면 연결하지 않는다. -- 연결 자체는 실제 증거 재검증이나 게시 승인 완료가 아니다. INSERT INTO announcement_attachment_policy_publication_scopes(id,policy_id,policy_row_version,rule_release_id,rule_row_version, mode_code,qa_run_id,qa_snapshot_hash,requested_by,idempotency_key,request_hash,reason_hash,expires_at) SELECT #{scopeId},p.id,p.row_version,p.rule_release_id,r.row_version,p.mode_code, CASE WHEN v.run_status_code='VERIFIED' AND v.policy_row_version=p.row_version AND v.rule_row_version=r.row_version THEN v.id END, CASE WHEN v.run_status_code='VERIFIED' AND v.policy_row_version=p.row_version AND v.rule_row_version=r.row_version THEN v.snapshot_hash END, #{actorId},#{key},#{requestHash},#{reasonHash},clock_timestamp()+interval '10 minutes' FROM announcement_attachment_policies p JOIN announcement_source_classification_rule_releases r ON r.id=p.rule_release_id LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT q.id,q.run_status_code,q.policy_row_version,q.rule_row_version,q.snapshot_hash FROM announcement_attachment_policy_validation_runs q WHERE q.policy_id=p.id AND q.rule_release_id=p.rule_release_id ORDER BY q.created_at DESC,q.id DESC LIMIT 1) v ON true WHERE p.id=#{policyId} AND p.row_version=#{expectedVersion} AND p.policy_status_code='DRAFT' AND r.release_status_code='ACTIVE'

-- DB 안에서 전체 범위를 복사한다. 클라이언트의 ID 목록·최대 건수·관측 hash를 받지 않는다. INSERT INTO announcement_attachment_policy_publication_scope_items(scope_id,entity_type_code,entity_id,state_hash) SELECT #{scopeId},m.entity_type_code,m.entity_id,m.state_hash FROM attachment_policy_publication_members(#{policyId}) m
mapper.update: -- 생성 transaction에서만 정확한 전체 항목을 한 번 봉인한다. 정책/worker/source는 수정하지 않는다. UPDATE announcement_attachment_policy_publication_scopes SET scope_status_code='SEALED', item_count=(SELECT count(1) FROM announcement_attachment_policy_publication_scope_items WHERE scope_id=#{scopeId}), scope_hash=attachment_policy_publication_scope_hash(#{scopeId}) WHERE id=#{scopeId} AND scope_status_code='OPEN' AND created_xid=pg_current_xact_id()
mapper.select: -- 정책 소속을 고정하여 다른 정책의 준비 원장을 조회하지 않는다. SELECT FROM announcement_attachment_policy_publication_scopes WHERE id=#{scopeId} AND policy_id=#{policyId} AND scope_status_code='SEALED'

-- 조회 snapshot 현재성만 확인한다. QA/런타임 최신성·승인·게시 가능 여부를 반환하는 쿼리가 아니다. SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM announcement_attachment_policy_publication_scopes s JOIN announcement_attachment_policies p ON p.id=s.policy_id JOIN announcement_source_classification_rule_releases r ON r.id=s.rule_release_id WHERE s.id=#{scopeId} AND s.scope_status_code='SEALED' AND s.expires_at>clock_timestamp() AND p.policy_status_code='DRAFT' AND p.row_version=s.policy_row_version AND p.mode_code=s.mode_code AND p.rule_release_id=s.rule_release_id AND r.row_version=s.rule_row_version AND r.release_status_code='ACTIVE' AND NOT EXISTS ((SELECT m.entity_type_code,m.entity_id,m.state_hash FROM attachment_policy_publication_members(s.policy_id) m) EXCEPT (SELECT i.entity_type_code,i.entity_id,i.state_hash FROM announcement_attachment_policy_publication_scope_items i WHERE i.scope_id=s.id)) AND NOT EXISTS ((SELECT i.entity_type_code,i.entity_id,i.state_hash FROM announcement_attachment_policy_publication_scope_items i WHERE i.scope_id=s.id) EXCEPT (SELECT m.entity_type_code,m.entity_id,m.state_hash FROM attachment_policy_publication_members(s.policy_id) m)))
-- 목록과 같은 소속/봉인 조건의 원래 이력 수다. SELECT count(1) FROM announcement_attachment_policy_publication_scopes WHERE policy_id=#{policyId} AND scope_status_code='SEALED'

-- 개별 ID와 상태 hash만 반환한다. source 내용·actor·요청 키·경로는 반환하지 않는다. SELECT i.entity_type_code,i.entity_id,i.state_hash FROM announcement_attachment_policy_publication_scope_items i JOIN announcement_attachment_policy_publication_scopes s ON s.id=i.scope_id WHERE s.policy_id=#{policyId} AND i.scope_id=#{scopeId} AND s.scope_status_code='SEALED' ORDER BY i.entity_type_code COLLATE "C",i.entity_id LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
